# Local private test media

Put real phone-exported test photos/videos here only for local manual testing.

Important rules:

- Do not commit real photos, videos, or metadata from your phone.
- This directory is ignored by Git except for this README.
- Use this area for vivo dual-file Live Photo samples, Google Photos exported samples, and other brand-specific files that may contain personal data.

Suggested local layout:

```text
testdata/local-private/
├── vivo-legacy-dual-file/
├── vivo-motion-photo/
├── google-photos/
└── other-brands/
```
